title: A PROPHETIC VISION FOR YOUR LIFE — GOD SENT ME TO TELL YOU THIS!
text: There are moments in destiny when heaven interrupts the schedule of men and says, "Now I must speak." Today is not another gathering of words. It is a prophetic appointment. [music] It is the voice of God calling a destiny back into alignment. Beloved, hear me. God never gives men years. He gives men opportunities inside of years. And when divine vision collides with human obedience, destiny opens like a scroll. [music] Tonight the Lord says, "I am releasing vision again, clear, sharp, and powerful." Proverbs 29:18, "Where there is no vision, the people perish." That word vision is not ambition. It is divine revelation of purpose. When a man loses sight of what God showed him, he begins to die gradually. But when vision returns, strength returns. When vision returns, direction returns. When vision returns, the future begins to speak [music] again. So today we cry, Lord, show me again. Show me the picture of my tomorrow. Show me why you preserved me. Show me the prophecy connected to my name. Show me the path of glory you ordained for me. Let every veil of confusion tear apart now in the name of Jesus. Genesis 15:5. And he brought Abraham forth abroad and said, [music] "Look now toward heaven and tell the stars, so shall thy seed be." Every vision begins with a call to look again. Someone under the sound of my voice, God is pulling you out of the tent of limitation. He is saying, "Step outside. Look higher. Dream again." You stop dreaming because of delay. But tonight, the spirit says, "Look up. The stars are still there. The promise is still valid. Lift your voice and declare, "Father, open my eyes to see what you see about my life. I refuse to call myself what life called me. I refuse to define myself by failure. I see myself as heaven sees me, redeemed, anointed, chosen, and sent." Ephesians 1:18, "The eyes of your understanding being enlightened that ye may know what is the hope of his calling. Let your eyes open tonight. The scales of ignorance fall off. The fog of confusion lifts. The spirit of wisdom and revelation rest upon you. Clarity is coming to your spirit. Direction is being downloaded into your heart." Someone listening now, the reason life feels stuck is because you lost the picture that gave you strength. But God says, "I am restoring prophetic [music] sight. Sights that sees beyond bills, beyond pain, beyond betrayal, sights that seize the throne even while standing in a cave." David said in Psalm 27:13, "I had fainted unless I had believed to see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living." The reason you fainted was because you stopped seeing. But from tonight, may your vision come alive again. I decree and declare the veil is lifted. The distraction is broken. The noise around your destiny is silenced. Every false voice that misdirected you IS JUDGED. EVERY COUNTERFEIT assignment is exposed. Receive the true blueprint of [music] your life. Hear me. A prophetic vision is not about ambition. It is about assignment. It is not a picture you draw. It is one God reveals. Jeremiah 1 vers5. Before I formed thee in the belly, I knew thee. Before thou camest forth, I sanctified thee and ordained thee a prophet unto the nations. That means purpose, premise preceded birth. You were not sent to experiment. You were sent to execute. You were born to be an answer. [music] You were born to reveal a dimension of God. And until you see that picture, you will live reacting to life [music] instead of commanding it. Lift your hands and cry, "Lord, reveal my assignment. Show me my portion in your program. Let every false pursuit die [music] tonight. Let every distraction lose power. Let my [music] life align with divine prophecy." Romans 8 19, the earnest expectation of the creator [music] waitth for the manifestation of the sons of God. Creation is waiting for you to see. The world is waiting for you to arise. Heaven is waiting for you to align. Now listen carefully. The Lord told Abraham, "Lift up your eyes." That was not physical. It was prophetic. Because every vision you cannot [music] see, you cannot possess. Genesis 13:14, "Lift up now thine eyes and look from the place where thou art." Notice God did not change Abraham's location before giving him vision. He said, "Look from the place where thou art." It means you can see glory from your valley. You can see the palace from the prison. You can see victory from the battlefield. Where you are is not the end. It is the lens through which God will show you what's next. Say this loud. Lord, give me eyes to see possibilities even in impossible places. I prophesy over you. Where men see walls, you will see doors. Where men see deserts, you will see rivers. Where men see failure, you will see formation. Where men see ashes, you will see beauty. The spirit of revelation rest upon you [music] tonight. The Lord says, "I am reactivating forgotten visions." Some of you once wrote them down. Then life mocked them out of your diary. Pick up that journal again. The instruction that look too big will now find resources. The idea that look impossible will now meet investors. The calling that look delayed will now find platform. This is your season of divine backing. Habacook 2:2. Write the vision and make it plain. Though it tar, wait for it because it will surely come. The vision may tar but it cannot die. Delay is not denial. Preparation is not punishment. The God who spoke has not changed his mind. Every prophetic word hanging over your life, I call it into remembrance. Every destiny project that stagnated receive breath again. Every dream business, EVERY MINISTRY, EVERY INVENTION, EVERY BOOK, EVERY assignment live again. Ezekiel 37 10. So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived and stood upon their feet, an exceeding great army. That breath is entering your vision tonight. It will stand up again. It will attract helpers again. It will bear fruit again. Someone under the sound of my voice, you are saying, "Lord, I don't even know what my vision is anymore." Hear the word of the Lord. I will cause you to remember the whispers of destiny. [music] There will be dreams, encounters, confirmations. The old fire will return. You will begin to see patterns that lead you back to purpose. The relationships meant for your vision will locate you. The environment required for your rising will draw you. The spirit of God will orchestrate divine alignment. Psalm 32:8 I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go. I will guide thee with mine eye. Receive divine instruction. Receive divine teaching. Receive divine guidance. [music] The compass of the spirit is turning you toward destiny. [music] Now lift your hands again. Say after me with faith. Father, in the name of Jesus, open the scroll of my destiny. Everything written concerning me that has not yet manifested, [music] let it begin to unfold. Let my life become the living prophecy of your intention. [music] And now by the spirit of prophecy, I [music] speak into your future. You will not miss your path. You will not be stranded in confusion. You will not waste your years chasing shadows. Your steps are ordered by the Lord. Your eyes are anointed to see. Your ears are anointed to hear. Your heart is anointed to understand. Proverbs 4:18, "The path of the just is as the shining light that shineth more and more unto the perfect day. From today, your path shines. [music] Your clarity increases. Your results multiply. You will discern seasons accurately. You will know what to do, when to move, and how to build. Your vision will no longer be blood. Your destiny will no longer be delayed." Give him praise [music] now. Begin to thank him for the vision that is returning. Thank him for the pictures forming again in your heart. Thank him for the power to pursue them. Thank him because this night marks the rebirth of destiny. Say, "Father, thank you. [music] I believe what you have shown me. I align my mind, my words, and my actions with your revelation." Something is shifting now. The [music] spirit of God is saying, I am not only restoring vision. I am empowering men to run with it. Because a vision without strength becomes frustration. A dream without motion becomes a museum. But tonight power is coming upon you to move. Acts 1:8. But ye shall receive power after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you and ye shall be witnesses. When the spirit comes, men who once feared begin to act. Timid hearts become trailblazers. Ordinary people become reformers. I decree receive that power now. Power to act, POWER TO BUILD, POWER TO FINISH, POWER TO RISE AGAIN. >> [music] >> There are three signs that divine vision has begun [music] to speak. First, a new hunger for righteousness. Second, a sudden restlessness for more. Third, doors begin to open [music] by favor. And the spirit says these signs will follow this message. You will wake up hungry to pray again. You will begin to feel uncomfortable staying small and strange doors will open [music] because heaven has authorized your next season. Isaiah 60:1, [music] "Arise, shine, for thy light is come and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee." [music] That light is not sunshine, it is revelation. When light comes, darkness [music] bows. When understanding comes, confusion dies. So I declare your light has come. Your clarity has come. Your time to shine has come. Beloved, listen carefully. [music] Every destiny rises on the wings of instruction. When God gives a vision, he sends a voice to interpret [music] it. Samuel had the voice for David. Elizabeth confirmed the voice for Mary. Tonight, God has sent this word as interpretation [music] for your next step. The confusion you carried into this meeting ends now. The Lord will begin to connect the dots you could not connect. You will see why the rejection had to happen. You will see why the door closed. You will see how pain became prophecy. Romans 8 28. And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God. All things, not some. Even betrayal is a teacher. Even delay is a tutor. Nothing in your journey will be wasted. Lift your voice and thank him. Lord, thank you because everything is working for my vision. Now I speak prophetically [music] for every person who lost the map of destiny. Heaven gives you a new compass. Your spirit will begin to discern the direction of God with precision. The fog around your next season clears now. The wrong people exit quietly. The right voices find you quickly. The right mentors, the right partners, the right investors, THE RIGHT HELPERS APPEAR [screaming] NOW. Isaiah 45:2, I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces [music] the gates of brass. That scripture is happening in your life. Crooked paths are straightening. Barriers are breaking. Systems are aligning. Policies will change to favor you. Protocols will bend to honor you. WHAT YOU COULD NOT ACHIEVE BY STRENGTH will open by remembrance. The spirit of the Lord says, "Tell my people, I am raising vision carriers, not echoers." The world has enough imitators. Now heaven needs imitiators. You will [music] not copy, you will create. You will not beg, you will build. You will not compete, you will complete destiny. Receive the grace for originality. Receive the mantle for creativity. Receive the wisdom to pioneer. Receive the boldness to be different. Isaiah 43:1 19, "Behold, [music] I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall ye not know it? That new thing will come to you. New songs, new systems, new businesses, new ministries, new expressions of grace. You are God's instrument [music] for the new. The world will look at you and say, "This must be God." Someone listening right now, you have been trying to interpret repeated dreams and visions about light, about nations, about stages. The Lord says it is not imagination. It is invitation. He is calling you into relevance beyond your environment. Nations will open their gates to you. Your voice will carry beyond language barriers. You will influence men you have never met. Psalm 2:8, "Ask of me and I shall give thee the heathen [music] for thine inheritance." Therefore, lift your hands and ask. Ask for nations. Ask for influence. Ask for wisdom to handle it. Ask for purity to sustain it. Ask for humility to manage it. [music] Ask for mercy to keep it. Now hear this warning. Wrapped in love. [music] Every vision without consecration will become corruption. [music] So tonight while power is being released, God is also calling you to purity [music] because vision without holiness becomes manipulation. Matthew 5:8, blessed are the pure in heart for they shall see God. See that only the pure see clearly. Purity preserves perception. [music] Guard your heart. It is the lens of your destiny. Bitterness will blow your vision. Offense will destroy your discernment. Unforgiveness will blind your eyes to opportunity. Let go of the weight. God is trying to hand you wings. Lift your hands and pray. Lord, purify my motives. Make my vision clean. May I not seek glory for myself, but for your name. The Lord says, I am reassigning mantles. For some of you, what your fathers carried is resting upon you tonight. You will continue their projects with greater wisdom. [music] You will perfect what they began. You will build what they only saw aire of. Hebrews 12:1, "Seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us run with patience the race that is set before us." The witnesses are watching. Heaven is cheering you on. You will not drop the baton. You will finish strong. The touch of vision will not die in your hand. Right now, I sense a release of angelic partnership. For every genuine assignment, there are angels assigned. Psalm 103:20, [music] "Bless the Lord, ye his angels that excel in strength, that do his commandments. Therefore, I [music] command the angelic to surround your destiny. Angels of favor, go before [music] them. Angels of protection encamp round about them. [music] Angels of provision deliver resources. Angels of remembrance whisper their names in places [music] of decision. You will see the fingerprints of angels in your results. [music] And now we raise a militant cry. Every force fighting your vision collapsed by fire. Every altar speaking limitation [music] be silenced. Every monitoring spirit assigned to your progress disappear. EVERY COVENANT of delay BE BROKEN. EVERY INHERITED CAUSE SAYING NO ONE RISES END TO LIGHT. EVERY DREAM ASSASSIN OF DESTINY BE ARRESTED. EVERY VOICE OF MOCKERY SHUT DOWN. EVERY WITCHCRAFT MANIPULATION AGAINST YOUR MIND SCATTER in the name of Jesus. Deuteronomy 28:7, "The Lord shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face." That scripture is active now. Your enemies fall before your face. They came in one way, they flee in seven. The siege IS OVER. THE YOKE IS BROKEN. THE CHAIN IS SLAPPED. THE PRISON IS OPEN. Lift your hands and begin to declare. My vision is preserved by fire. My destiny is sealed by covenant. My steps are ordered by wisdom. My helpers are aligned by grace. You will not fail midway. You will not miscarry destiny. You will not be distracted by applause. You will not be derailed by pride. You will finish what you start. You will shine brighter than your beginning. The hand of the Lord establishes you. Psalm 138:8. The Lord will perfect that which concerneth me. That is the prophecy over you tonight. [music] He will perfect it. Not halfway, not almost, but perfect. He began it, he will finish it. He started the vision, he will sustain it. He called you, he will glorify you. Give him praise now. Thank him for the power to run. Thank him because the fog is gone. Thank him because purpose has come alive. Thank him because angels have been dispatched. Thank him because your life has found direction. Say, "Father, I will not betray this revelation. I will guard this vision. I will walk with you until the picture becomes manifestation. The atmosphere has shifted again. The wind of prophecy is blowing over destinies, businesses, and families. The same God who restored Job in one day, who turned Joseph's prison into a palace, is breathing on your life right now. Every dry place begins to live again. Job 42 10. And the Lord turned the captivity of Job when he prayed for his friends. Also the Lord gave Job [music] twice as much as he had before. That verse is not history. It is prophecy. This is the night of your turning. What you lost in years, you will recover in moments. The hand of the restorer is stretching towards you. Say this with conviction. Lord, I receive restoration. Total complete supernatural. Every vision carries an [music] economy inside it. When God gives purpose, he provides provision. The spirit of the Lord says, "I am releasing resources for assignments. [music] No more begging to build what heaven commanded. No more lack in the midst of prophecy. The ravens are coming with bread. The doors of supply are opening. [music] The mantle of Joseph that manages plenty is resting on you. Deuteronomy 8:18. But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth. [music] That power is not greed. It is grace to create. Ideas are descending now. Strategies are being born. Partnerships are aligning. The spirit of innovation is awakening. [music] Before the end of this quarter, you will stand as proof that God funds his vision. I decree and declare your hands are blessed. Your mind is fruitful. Your atmosphere attracts resources. Money will serve destiny in your life. Favor [snorts] will sponsor your assignment. You will not labor under close heavens. From tonight the earth will yield increase to you. Someone under the sound of my voice. You have watched others build while you wait. But hear the word of the Lord. Your waiting has qualified you for wisdom. Now when you rise, you will not collapse. The delay was training. The silence was sharpening. The pain was proof of process. Isaiah 61:7, "For your shame ye shall have double, and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion. Therefore, I prophesy double restoration, double for the years of obscurity, double for the mockery, double for the betrayal, double for the closed doors. Let the God of recompense arise for you." Now, I speak to the realm of destiny helpers. There are men and women assigned to remember you [music] and the spirit of the Lord is moving them now. Esther 6:1 on that night could not the king sleep. That same sleeplessness visits those ordained to favor you. They will call your name in boardrooms. They will recommend you in places of influence. They will speak for you even when you are not present. Your file is being brought to the top of the pile. The season of being ignored is over. The king will [music] send for you. Say it. My name is remembered in places of honor. The [music] spirit says, I am also visiting families. Every household swallowed by cycles of loss. Deliverance has come. Psalm 112:2. His seed shall be mighty upon earth. [clears throat] The generation [music] of the upright shall be blessed. That blessing now rest on your bloodline. Altars of failure break. Altars of sickness burn. Altars of premature death scatter. Altars of poverty collapse. The cause of rising and falling [music] broken forever. The Lord is rewriting your family story. You will be the first of a new order of greatness. Lift your right hand and declare these [music] prophetic decrees. By the blood of Jesus, my lineage is redeemed. By mercy, the old patterns are erased. By grace, we step into [music] generational blessing. From today, our name is associated with favor, not shame. Numbers 23 23. Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. So I decree, every curse spoken in ignorance. Every evil word projected in jealousy is cancelled by the blood. Every arrow sent against your house returns to sender. Every monitoring spirit loses signal. The wall of fire surrounds you. THE MARK OF CHRIST DISTINGUISHES YOU. Now the Lord says, "Prophesy over health because what use his vision without vitality?" 3 John 1:2, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper [music] and be in health. Therefore, every sickness in the body, in the blood, in the bones, go. Every weakness that drains strength, be healed. Every diagnosis that frightened you, be overturned. Every hereditary affliction, stop now. From the crown of your head to the soles of your feet, the life of God flows. The same spirit that raised Christ from the dead quickens your mortal body. You will live long. You will live strong. Your years will not be cut short. Lift your voice. Lord, my body is your temple. LET YOUR FIRE burn away infirmity. And now prophetic restoration over time itself. Joel 2 25. [music] I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten. Years can be wasted, but years can also be restored. God is compressing lost seasons into one encounter. The delay of 10 years will be answered in 10 days. The harvest of many sowings will appear at once. This is divine acceleration. [music] I decrease speed into your destiny, speed in understanding, speed in manifestation, speed in relationships, speed in achievement, [music] speed that confounds onlookers. Others may have gone ahead, but mercy gives you wings. You will arrive first, though you started last. Psalm [music] 18: 29. By my God have I leaped over a wall. That leaping grace comes upon you now. Every wall of limitation collapses. Every mountain of resistance levels. You will leap where others crawl. You will excel where others struggle. Beloved, destiny vision is not only to see far. It is to live ready. So the Lord says consecrate again because what he is giving will require capacity. [music] Lay down small thinking. Lay down laziness. Lay down fear. Lay down sin that easily entangles. Hebrews 12:1. Let us lay aside every weight. You cannot fly with weights. You cannot build with distractions. The next level demands discipline. [music] Grace for discipline is released upon you. And now the atmosphere becomes warfare. Every demonic embargo on your destiny I confronted by the blood. Powers that vowed you will not rise be judged. Networks that trap potential scatter. Evil hands manipulating your progress wither. Voices speaking delay into your season be silenced. This is your midnight of liberty. The lion of Judah roars over your life. Let every pharaoh release you now. Let every red sea part before you. Let every Jordan open at your approach. You are coming out of captivity. Exodus 14 13. The Egyptians whom ye have seen today, ye shall see them again no more forever. Say it loud. No more. >> NO MORE STAGNATION. NO MORE REJECTION. NO MORE CONFUSION. NO MORE FINANCIAL DROUGHT. NO MORE night seasons without dawn. Now begin to thank him. Thank him because the chains are broken. [music] Thank him because the decree has been issued. Thank him because the angels have gone ahead. Thank him because the vision leaves again. Say, "Father, I receive grace to run. I receive [music] wisdom to build. I receive favor to finish." Philippians 1 6. He which had begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ. That good work is already in motion. What started as prophecy will end as testimony. You will look back and say the Lord has done great things for me. The wind of the spirit is moving again. This time it is not personal. [music] It is generational. The Lord says I am not only giving you vision. I am giving you an inheritance among them that are sanctified. [music] What he begins in you will echo in many after you. Psalm 22:30. A seed shall serve him. [music] It shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation. You are that seed. Your obedience tonight [music] is birthing a generation of light. Every family represented here, hear the word of the Lord. You will not end as consumers of mercy. You will become distributors of [music] mercy. You will not end as recipients of help. You will become channels of help. You will not end as seekers of revival. [music] You will become carriers of revival. The oil that rests on you will overflow to cities. [music] Your light will not be hidden. Your voice will not be silenced. You will be a reference of [music] what grace can make of a man. Isaiah 60:3, "And [music] the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising." Kings are coming. Influence is coming. [music] Visibility is coming, not to exalt pride, but to reveal Christ through excellence. Receive the anointing for relevance [music] without compromise. receive the mantle for dominion without corruption. Now let us prophesy over nations. Father, we decree that righteousness rises again in our lands. Let corruption bow to integrity. Let hatred give way to unity. Let the sound of revival drown the noise of rebellion. Psalm 33:12. Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord. We call our nations blessed. We call our schools blessed. We call our governments blessed. We call our youth affl with purpose. Let a new breed without greed arise. Young men and women who fear the Lord, who carry light into systems, who restore dignity to leadership where there has been bloodshed. Let there be peace. Where there has been manipulation, let there be justice. Where there has been despair, let there be hope. The banner of the Lord is lifted over our nations. [music] And now to you, destiny carrier. Your generation will not forget your obedience. The books of heaven will record your faithfulness. You will build what others only imagined. You will rise beyond limitation. You will become the answer to the prayers of many. People will encounter God through your vision. Romans 8 30. Whom he called them he also justified. And whom he justified [music] them he also glorified. You have been called. You have been justified. Now step [music] into glory. Every veil covering your distinction is torn. Every delay in manifestation is removed. Walk into glory. [music] Walk into evidence. Walk into favor. Walk into speed. Say aloud, I walk in glory. My vision speaks. The spirit of the Lord says, I am giving new strength for new responsibility. Some of you are entering phases that will demand more prayer, more discipline, more compassion, more generosity, but grace will match the weight. Isaiah 40:31, they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings as eagles. You will not be weary in destiny. You will not faint under pressure. When others retire, you will refire. The eagle grace to soar higher every season rests upon you now. [music] Now we raise a final warfare decree. Every satanic embargo over your nation, over your tribe, over your generation be broken. Powers that buried greatness, release it. Structures that oppress righteousness crumble. Voices that sponsor darkness be [music] silenced. Let the ALTARS OF BAL FALL BEFORE THE ARK of the Lord. Let the spirit of Jezebel lose her throne. Let every counterfeit light be exposed. Let the true sons of God arise with wisdom and fire. Psalm 68:1. Let God arise. Let his enemies be scattered. We declare God has arisen over our cities. The enemies of progress are scattered. The enemies of truth are scattered. The enemies of purpose ARE SCATTERED. LIGHT PREVAILS. Truth triumphs. Jesus reigns. Now lift your voice in thanksgiving. [music] Thank him for the nations he will touch through you. Thank him for the institutions that will be redeemed through your excellence. Thank him for the families that will be restored through your obedience. Thank him because his plan is bigger than your fear, greater than your weakness, stronger than your limitation. Say, Lord, I thank you. I am part of your prophetic agenda. I [music] refuse to be silent when destiny calls. I refuse to sleep when purpose beckons. [music] I arise and shine. Psalm 126:3. [music] The Lord has done great things for us whereof we are glad. Let gladness fill your heart now. The burden of confusion is lifted. The heaviness of delay is gone. The shadow of uncertainty is replaced by the light of vision. You are marching into manifestation. [music] Now, as we seal this prophetic vision with thanksgiving, Father, thank you for the word spoken. Thank you for [music] the destinies revived. Thank you for the visions reignited. Thank you for the grace [music] to run and not be weary. Thank you because the nations will see your glory through [music] these ones. Thank you for angels already assigned to guard, guide, and provide. Thank you for the testimonies that will follow. We seal this night with gratitude, faith, and joy. Philippians 4 7. And the peace of God which passes all understanding shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus. Peace like a river floods your heart now. Peace in your home. Peace in your mind. Peace in your pursuits. Peace in your transitions. Peace that speaks louder than storms. And now the final benediction. May the Lord bless you and keep you. May his face shine upon you and give you peace. May his hand rest upon you for lifting. May his mercy crown every new beginning. May his favor distinguish you among many. May his vision to you never die. From this day, you are a walking prophecy. Your life will speak louder than your words. The world will see and glorify your father in heaven. Go forth in strength.
